does: Start text that tells the main chat which agent tier fits a job.

children.does: A table of the agent tiers, with one row for each agent that runs.
The row for small jobs that end in a report, done by scout.
The row for reading, research, test runs and edits that follow a plan, done by researcher and worker.
The row for jobs that need judgement, done by builder and reviewer.
The row for plans and specs that code will follow, done by planner.
The row for reviews where a miss is expensive, done by critic.
A job of several steps goes to an agent, and a quick check does not.
A job between two tiers goes to the higher one.
A weak result runs again one tier up, never on the same tier.
A cheaper agent's claim is checked before anything is built on it.
An agent sends back anything public as the exact text, for the user to decide.
An agent's description starts with its model in brackets, so the task list shows the tier.

reason_not_in.cursor: Cursor's Task input is known only from its docs, so hub does not stop agent calls there yet.

children.does: Stops an agent call that sets no model and starts no tier agent, and names the tiers that run. While it is off, it only counts such calls.
More agent names the guard lets through, such as a built-in agent you trust with the main chat's model.
